obtainedFrom.title: Check for 2027 changes, 28 Nov 2026
obtainedFrom.note: SB 392 (2026) set 2.11% to 4.58% from 2026 (W. Va. Code §11-21-4j). §11-21-4h allows a further cut from 1 January 2027 of up to 10% if excess revenue is certified after 15 August; no certification or Tax Commissioner notice was found. The $2,000 exemption is fixed in statute.
